in_sanskrit.name: दिनेशकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दिनेश (Dinesh) - God of prosperity, कुमार (Kumar) - young man, son

in_hindi.name: दिनेशकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिनेश (Dinesh) - देव (dev) का नाम, दिन का राजा (ruler of the day), दिनेशकुमार - वृद्ध दिनेश का सून (son)

in_tamil.name: தினேஷ்குமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: தினம் (Thinam) - நாள் (day), இஷ் (Ish) - இஷ்வர் (Ishvar) - இஷ்வர்கள் (Ishvaral) - God, குமார் (Kumar) - young man, ஸூன் (Soon) - son

in_telugu.name: దినేశ్కూపార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: దినేశ (Dinesh) - దీప్యేహోదేశ (DipyayudhEshwara) - దినేశపిటీపొయ్యేశ్ (DineshPitadev) - God of the day, కూపార్ (Kumar) - young man, సూయోజ్జ (Sooyojj) - son

in_marathi.name: Dineshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's guardian, protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dineshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dineshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Dine meaning 'God' and Ish meaning 'protector' or 'God's guardian'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be born to protect and serve as a guardian for his family or community.

in_bengali.name: Dineshkumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's guardian, protector
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dineshkumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dineshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Dine meaning 'God' and Ish meaning 'protector' or 'God's guardian'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be born to protect and serve as a guardian for his family or community.
